ML Engineer - Demand Forecasting - FreshCart Grocery (Austin, TX / hybrid)

FreshCart is a regional grocery chain with 140 stores. Our forecasting team predicts demand for 30,000 products every day.

Responsibilities
- Build, deploy and maintain time series forecasting models (LightGBM, XGBoost, Prophet, deep learning) at store/SKU level
- Productionize models with Airflow, Docker and CI/CD; monitor drift and accuracy (MAPE, WAPE, bias)
- Work with merchandising and supply chain to turn forecasts into replenishment decisions
- Improve feature engineering: promotions, holidays, weather, price elasticity

Requirements
- 3+ years in data science or ML engineering
- Python (pandas, scikit-learn, LightGBM), SQL, Snowflake
- Experience taking models from notebook to production
- Model monitoring and experiment tracking (MLflow)
- Clear communication with non-technical stakeholders
Bonus: retail forecasting experience, dbt, cloud (AWS or GCP)
